name: callout
title: Callout
description: HBD status callout: info / warning / error / success saturated surfaces plus the HBD-specific "sage-advice" advisory variant (pale-gold dashed accent, serif-italic body). Optional bold title (wires aria-labelledby) and a dismissible button whose collapse animation (opacity + max-height + padding + margin on --hbd-duration-slow) fires onDismiss once before unmount. Variant drives role: note (info/success/sage-advice), status (warning), alert (error).
